description: This header defines a lock-free sample recorder for profiling, including templates for Sample and SampleRecorder classes, managing samples and their lifecycle with thread safety, and internal data structures for sample tracking.

classes.name: Sample
classes.description: Template struct representing a sample with linking members for a lock-free linked list.

classes.name: SampleRecorder
classes.description: Template class managing a thread-safe collection of samples, supporting registration, unregistration, iteration, and configuration of maximum sample count.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a new sample with optional arguments, possibly reusing dead samples.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a sample, moving it to the dead list.

methods.name: SetDisposeCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback to be called on samples when they are unregistered.

methods.name: Iterate
methods.description: Iterates over all live samples, applying a provided function.

methods.name: SetMaxSamples
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of samples allowed.

methods.name: GetMaxSamples
methods.description: Returns the current maximum sample limit.
